label: Anti-DEI allocator transfer
supported_statement: Five exact executive or personnel instruments changed selector authority, evaluative criteria, or the admissibility of DEI, affirmative-action, disparate-impact, contractor, or Foreign Service evidence.
evidence_ceiling: The records support bounded allocator and admissibility transfer. They do not establish that every displaced program was lawful or effective, a complete racial order, prevalence, or practical correction monopoly.
next_required_records: complete affected-program and affected-person denominators
implementation, enforcement, appeal, and outcome records
practical timing, cost, durability, and effectiveness of correction

label: Public conversion into selected private capacity
supported_statement: A named Defense Production Act award joined public funding and validation to selected private production capacity.
evidence_ceiling: The record does not establish the complete supplier universe, award terms, comparative performance, substitution capacity, or public recovery.
next_required_records: complete applicant and supplier denominator
evaluation and award terms
milestones, performance, failure, substitution, and public recovery

label: Effective independent counterpower controls
supported_statement: Independent judicial and procurement-review bodies preserved evidence and created a binding correction pathway without predetermining the underlying merits.
evidence_ceiling: The controls demonstrate that correction can work at a bounded gate. They do not establish system-wide adequacy or final downstream compliance.
next_required_records: final remand or corrective-action outcomes
cost, delay, durability, and recurrence after correction

label: Ordinary industrial-policy controls
supported_statement: Named strategic-finance and CHIPS instruments show that purposive public selection can coexist with disclosed instruments, due diligence or milestones, and formal oversight.
evidence_ceiling: The controls prevent public preference, national-security framing, or private benefit from becoming automatic capture findings. Final performance and recovery remain open.
next_required_records: complete applicant denominators
operative agreements and disbursement records
performance, enforcement, repayment, clawback, and public recovery

label: Open selector and strategic-capital denominators
supported_statement: NatSec100, SBIC Critical Technologies, and Office of Strategic Capital selection surfaces are source-addressable and partially denominator-bounded.
evidence_ceiling: Selected rosters, aggregate applicant counts, named instruments, and methodology categories do not supply complete preselection universes, rejected rows, exact scoring, terms, performance, failure, or recovery.
next_required_records: complete candidate and applicant universes
all rejected, ineligible, withdrawn, and failed rows
exact scoring, committee, FOCI, underwriting, and adverse-decision custody
commitment, draw, disbursement, performance, default, repayment, and public-recovery records
bounded later capital, award, deployment, failure, and nonaward joins

label: Stronger merit-circularity inference refused
supported_statement: A first-party narrative linked public support, capacity growth, supplier status, and later contracts.
refused_statement: The record does not establish that public conversion caused the later success, that the selected company displaced comparable alternatives, or that retained private value became proof of intrinsic merit.
next_required_records: official award instrument and exact terms
complete comparator and supplier universe
independent performance and failure evidence
public contribution, rights, recovery, and residual-value chronology
